package rulefixtures

import (
	"database/sql"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for sql_query_constants_outside_repository_package: Raw query templates stored in handlers, services, or DTO packages instead of repository-adjacent files.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

const getUsersSQL = "SELECT id, name, email, role FROM users WHERE active = $1"
const insertUserSQL = "INSERT INTO users (name, email) VALUES ($1, $2) RETURNING id"
const deleteUserSQL = "DELETE FROM users WHERE id = $1"
const searchUsersSQL = "SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE name ILIKE $1"

func UserHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, db *sql.DB) {
	rows, err := db.QueryContext(r.Context(), getUsersSQL, true)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "failed", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	fmt.Fprint(w, `{"users":[]}`)
}
